Package org.apache.juneau.bean.jsonrpc

Class JsonRpcResponse

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.bean.jsonrpc.JsonRpcResponse
@Marshalled public class JsonRpcResponse extends Object
JSON-RPC 2.0 success or error response envelope.

Exactly one of result or error should be present for a valid response.

This envelope is generic JSON-RPC 2.0 and carries no _meta property: MCP-specific per-result metadata belongs under result._meta, not beside the envelope. See the 2026-07-28 v2 bean package (org.apache.juneau.bean.mcp.v20260728) for the typed nested carrier.

    • notification

      public static boolean notification(Object id)
      Tests whether a JSON-RPC id identifies a notification (a request that must not be answered).

      A JSON-RPC request with no id is a notification; the server performs the work and returns no response body.

      Parameters:
      id - The request id. Can be null.
      Returns:
      true if the id is null.
